purpose: Frozen common-universe baseline and separated research, not certification
universe: Every official KXBTC15M contract opening in each half-open UTC window, reconciled against EVERY scheduled 900-second UTC slot.
denominators: Retain missed/offline/late-join/source-unqualified/no-call slots; report official and scheduled denominators separately.

main.restart_rule: Any main process restart closes this runtime identity; weights not exported.

collection.scope: Sampled API states and accepted clean inputs. Five-second phase sampling can miss signals and alias freshness.

call_rule: First strict source-qualified call per lane/contract after official open and before close at actual observer response time. Report server-generated eligibility separately; retain flips/lifecycle. Do not treat retained pre-window entries as new.
paths: Executable side bid minus signal ask at qualified observations. Report missing intervals and sampled MFE/MAE censoring; no fill/net-profit claim.
labels: Official finalized Kalshi responses stored separately after close; never input to features. Final-60 comparison uses true BRTI publications only.
revision_change_rule: Close affected strategy/runtime identity at first change; retain every scheduled slot and outage. Never pool replacement runs or extend based on performance. Candidate policies need a separate immutable pre-validation manifest on this universe.
holdout_rule: No outcome analysis, tuning or selection before fixed holdout end. Previously inspected or identity-invalid data cannot certify untouched holdout. Report invalidated windows and register replacements prospectively.
